title: 第17章 找梅姐帮忙第18章 都给我住手
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳坐着出租车，一路疾驰，很快回到了自己的出租屋。
他随手将装着两百万现金的钱袋藏在床底的暗格中，又拉上床单掩盖好。
目光扫过这张熟悉的床，他脑海里瞬间浮出昨晚唐欣悦与赵凯背叛他的画面。
陈阳一下握紧拳头，指甲深深嵌进掌心，带来一阵尖锐的疼痛。
眼底的怒火几乎要喷薄而出。
他咬牙切齿说：“唐欣悦、赵凯，我一定会让你们后悔！让你们付出惨痛的代价！”
深吸一口气，他强压下心头的暴怒，扭头从出租屋出来。
夜色深沉，路灯将他的影子拉得很长。
很快，他乘车来到了江河别墅区，然后步行走到8号别墅外。
远远地，他一眼看到前头停放着的一辆白色轿车，车上坐着的，正是他的嫂子宋萌萌。
她正微微侧着头，目光望向别墅方向，显然已经在这里等待了很久。
陈阳心里一暖，又有些意外。
嫂子怎么在这里？
看样子，她是放心不下自己，特意过来了。
他悄悄躲到旁边一棵茂密的香樟树后，双眼一凝，瞬间开启透视眼，目光穿透厚重的墙壁和门窗，仔细扫过别墅的每一个角落。
却发现里面空无一人，只有几个保安在门口巡逻。
此时已经是晚上11点半，肖明轩竟然还没有回来。
陈阳拿出手机，想要拨打宋萌萌的电话，编个借口让她先回去，别在这里蹚浑水。
就在这时，两道车灯的强光突然刺破夜色。
一辆红色的限量版跑车，伴随着刺耳的刹车声，与一辆黑色的商务车一前一后，驶停在8号别墅门口。

跑车车门打开，下来一名年轻男人。
他穿着一身白色名牌西装，头发梳得油光水滑，脸上带着一副金丝边眼镜，眼神里透着傲慢和轻佻，嘴角挂着一抹玩世不恭的笑意。
他正是肖明轩。
肖明轩转头看向身后的商务车，脸上的笑容瞬间敛去，变得阴鸷起来。
商务车的车门“哐当”一声被拉开，三名穿着黑色西装、身材高大的保镖，从车上强行拽下来一名十八九岁的少女。
那少女穿着一身干净的校服，背着一个粉色的书包，看起来清纯又稚嫩，脸上满是惊恐和无助。
她双手被保镖反扭在身后，拼命挣扎，却怎么也挣脱不开，长发凌乱地贴在脸颊上，眼眶通红，泪水在里面打转。
“你们干什么？放开我！我不认识你们！快放开我！”少女的声音带着哭腔，尖锐而颤抖，拼命想要呼救，却被保镖捂住了嘴巴，只能发出呜呜的闷响。
肖明轩冷笑一声，眼神里满是不屑和占有欲，语气冰冷说：“带到我房间里去，别让她跑了。”
说完，他扭头就朝着别墅大门走去，步伐傲慢，仿佛这一切都是理所当然。
两名保镖抓着少女，紧随其后。
眼看他们就要进入别墅，宋萌萌突然从白色轿车上冲了下来。
她脸上满是焦急和愤怒，快步冲到众人面前，声音带着一丝颤抖却异常坚定地喊道：“给我站住！！”
所有人都停下脚步，纷纷转头看向突然出现的宋萌萌。
content_en:
Chen Yang drove quickly in a taxi and soon returned to his rental house.
He casually hid the money bag containing two million in cash in a secret compartment under the bed, and then pulled up the sheets to cover it up.
His eyes swept over this familiar bed, and the scene of Tang Xinyue and Zhao Kai betraying him last night instantly came to his mind.
Chen Yang clenched his fists, and his nails dug deeply into his palms, causing a sharp pain.
The anger in his eyes almost burst out.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Tang Xinyue, Zhao Kai, I will definitely make you regret it! I will make you pay a heavy price!"
Taking a deep breath, he suppressed the rage in his heart and turned around and walked out of the rental house.
The night was dark, and the streetlights stretched his shadow very long.
Soon, he took a car to the Jianghe Villa area, and then walked outside Villa No. 8.
From a distance, he saw a white car parked in front of him. Sitting in the car was his sister-in-law Song Mengmeng.
She was tilting her head slightly and looking towards the direction of the villa, obviously she had been waiting here for a long time.
Chen Yang felt warm and a little surprised.
Why is sister-in-law here?
It seemed that she was worried about herself and came here specially.
He quietly hid behind a dense camphor tree nearby, focused his eyes, and instantly opened his clairvoyance eyes. His gaze penetrated the thick walls, doors and windows, and carefully scanned every corner of the villa.
Only to find that there was no one inside, except for a few security guards patrolling the door.
It was already 11:30 in the evening, and Xiao Mingxuan hadn't come back yet.
Chen Yang took out his cell phone and wanted to call Song Mengmeng, making up an excuse to ask her to go back first instead of wading in muddy waters here.
At this moment, the bright light of two car lights suddenly pierced the night.
A red limited edition sports car, accompanied by the screeching sound of brakes, and a black business car stopped in front of Villa No. 8, one behind the other.
The door of the sports car opened and a young man got out.
He was wearing a white designer suit, his hair was slicked, and he wore a pair of gold-rimmed glasses. His eyes were arrogant and frivolous, and there was a cynical smile on his lips.
He is Xiao Mingxuan.
Xiao Mingxuan turned to look at the commercial car behind him, and the smile on his face instantly faded and turned sinister.
The door of the commercial car was opened with a clang, and three tall bodyguards in black suits forcibly pulled an eighteen-year-old girl out of the car.
The girl was wearing a clean school uniform and carrying a pink schoolbag. She looked innocent and childish, with a face full of fear and helplessness.
Her hands were twisted behind her by the bodyguard, and she struggled desperately, but she couldn't get free. Her long hair was messy and stuck to her cheeks, and her eyes were red with tears.
"What are you doing? Let me go! I don't know you! Let me go!" The girl's voice was tearful, sharp and trembling. She desperately wanted to call for help, but the bodyguard covered her mouth, and she could only make a muffled sound.
Xiao Mingxuan sneered, his eyes full of disdain and possessiveness, and said in a cold tone: "Take her to my room, don't let her run away."
After saying that, he turned around and walked towards the door of the villa with an arrogant pace, as if everything was taken for granted.
Two bodyguards grabbed the girl and followed closely behind.
Just as they were about to enter the villa, Song Mengmeng suddenly rushed out of the white car.
Her face was full of anxiety and anger, and she rushed to the crowd quickly, her voice trembling but extremely firm and shouting: "Stop!!"
Everyone stopped and turned to look at Song Mengmeng who suddenly appeared.
